item.title: All-Pro Fasteners Celebrates 50 Years
item.description: Based in Arlington, TX, APF is a full-line, full-service fastener company that manufactures and distributes bolts, nuts, washers, screws and fastener-related components throughout the U.S.

item.title: Space-Lok Names Engineering/Quality Director
item.description: New director joined Space-Lok in 2020 from LISI Aerospace, where he worked from 2015-2020.

item.title: Arrow Tool Laying Off 140 Workers in New Jersey
item.description: Arrow’s facility in Saddle Brook, NJ, serves as the U.S. sales, marketing, and distribution hub for parent company Hangzhou GreatStar Industrial Co.

item.title: Simpson Retiring from Stelfast
item.description: He joined Stelfast in 2011 as National Sales Manager before his promotion to Division President in 2020.

item.title: Howmet Hires Procurement & Supply Chain Manager

item.title: Grainger Canada Names Sales Manager

item.title: Gabriel India Ltd. Finalizes Fastener JV

item.description: “I’m excited for the opportunity to expand our footprint, strengthen partnerships, and continue building a best‑in‑class platform in this market.”
